Put the registration link (Luma or Meetup) in url. venue is a name (same in both languages) or { "en": ..., "pt": ... }. Times are Lisbon time. Write "18:00-20:00" to give the end time. en.title: Guest lecture: Transitioning into AI safety
en.summary: Alexander Müller (Safe AI Netherlands) and Weronika Zurek (BlueDot) talk about how to move into AI safety and how to use the skills you already have. Part of the fellowship, open to everyone. Bring your questions.

pt.title: Palestra convidada: a transição para a segurança da IA
pt.summary: Alexander Müller (Safe AI Netherlands) e Weronika Zurek (BlueDot) falam sobre como fazer a transição para a segurança da IA e como aproveitar as competências que já tens. Faz parte do fellowship, aberta a todos. Traz as tuas perguntas.
